name: talk-away-train-or-pause
why: Coach exam 18 Nov 2026: 'hold everything until I'm home' was answered with a fortnight of bodyweight sessions. Away is not always a kit change. Turn 0 says he is away and says nothing about training, so the coach asks which, once: train with what is there, or pause until he is back. No offer yet. Turn 1 answers pause, and must reach the pause, never different kit, a rest day or moved sessions.
messages: I'm in Lisbon with work all of next week
pause it till I'm back please
